reviews.title: A Proper Review
reviews.text:
I’ve seen many reviews claiming consistent crashing but I for one have yet to have any sort of problem (IPhone 16), that aside lets get into the actual review;
• Art: (9/10) The quality is amazing especially when put at max settings, just be prepared for lower frames if you aren’t using a high end phone.
• Gameplay: (7/10) it’s an alright turn based game, I just wish the devs included a guide with an in-depth guide to all the different stats, UI, and effects. I found it all to be a bit confusing and hard to understand at first.
• Progression: (6.5/10) The game gets difficult somewhat quickly, especially if you’re a free to play player. Don’t get me wrong, it’s 100% doable without spending money, it’s just a slower progress, and since it’s not a pvp game, the slow progress can be a good or bad thing depending on who you ask. Proper gear, party level, and strategy is needed to pass higher levels.
• Expenses: (7/10) as stated before you don’t need to spend money to progress, especially since it’s not pvp you can use this game purely as a time killer. However, some of the skins are definitely worth it for reasons I’ll mention in the next section. The materials and such you can get from packs are also nice to help ease the difficulty of higher levels, but again, this isn’t really a pay2win game, more like…pay2goon?
• Rating: (18+) for once the adult rating is actually justified. Obviously apple TOS won’t allow anything crazy so don’t get your hopes up, however the skins that can be purchased are definitely of a high quality lewd degree, and in my opinion, even better than most of the other ‘gooner’ games on the App Store. The eye candy is perfect!
• Overall: (7.5/10) add an in-depth guide, balance out the difficulty of the levels a bit, and add some stat bonuses to the outfits and I’d say this game can easily reach 10/10.

*side note for the devs: keep up the good work with said outfits, you obviously know what 18+ means and know exactly how to attract attention to detail just right. Can’t wait to see what other designs you come out with.*

reviews.title: We Meet Again Men Of Culture..
reviews.text:
I haven’t experienced any crashes the game runs pretty good, EXTREMELY F2P Friendly, Many cosmetics and currency is plentiful if you save with a wide variety of characters, I was hesitant because how the models looked. 

It grew on me pretty fast mainly because of the Swamp Elves (Brown characters.) I thought Elves were just Elves, I guess they didn’t want to call them dark elves for racial sensitivity (Thanks developers for being a homie.) but the name is weird though like these hoes from the swamp with Shrek and Donkey? 

I also I don’t understand entering a name then everyone just calls you HUMAN GOD. A bit blasphemous for my taste so I skip most of the dialogue.
(I know you skip too.)

But I digress, Overall 5 stars in my book because of the f2p treatment, UI, easy to pick up and play, competent auto mode, great costumes, interactive features, and wide variety of swamp elves (most these games have 1 or 2) so there’s a great chance I’ll soak some money in this game and make it a “guilty pleasure” game and to support the developers solely because of the Swamp elves, thank you developers.
Love me some brown sugar.
